description: Ownership gate: in repos that use it, reminds Claude to run the ownership check, installs the local pre-push hook, and stops Claude from pushing a change nobody verified. Does nothing in other repos. If Node.js is missing, SessionStart tells Claude to say so and PreToolUse steps aside.

hooks.command: command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"Comprende could not start: node is not on PATH. Tell the user in one line that Comprende needs Node.js 20 or newer (install it from https://nodejs.org), then a restart of Claude Code."}}'; exit 0; }; node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/dist/gate.mjs" session-start || printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"Comprende could not start: this Node.js could not run it. Tell the user in one line that Comprende needs Node.js 20 or newer (install it from https://nodejs.org), then a restart of Claude Code."}}'
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/dist/gate.mjs" claude-hook --from-plugin
